bb=None

    p0=np.r_[np.random.RandomState(s).uniform(0.3,1.5,5)*np.array([1,7,0.5,0.02,0.05]), 1.0]

    if bb is None or rr.cost<bb.cost: bb=rr
p=bb.x; r=y-model(p)
